## What and why

## How it was verified

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm package:check` passes (public exports, declarations, CSS or packaging changed)
- [ ] Keyboard, light/dark and narrow-width behaviour checked where the change is visible
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changed
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
